name: ask_human
description: Stop and ask a human for help. Sets status to 'stuck', shows the blocker card, and posts the question in chat. Use after two failed attempts, or for any missing secret, access, or decision.

title.description: Short blocker name, e.g. 'Stripe key rejected (401)'.

detail.description: What failed and the exact error.

question.description: The question to the human, phrased so it can be answered in one reply.

suggestions.description: One-tap replies, e.g. 'I rotated the key, retry'.
